a.text: Tool planners choose the correct operation before execution.

b.text: Adapters report success before verifying the external postcondition.

expected.text: Planning accuracy can improve while end-to-end agent reliability falls because execution success is unverified.

reference_claims.text: 100 correctly planned mutations → intended external postcondition observed → ≥99

reference_invariants: neither parent alone entails the planning-to-outcome gap

a.text: Parallel tool calls reduce median task latency.

b.text: Several tools mutate shared workspace state.

expected.text: Parallelism turns shared-state tools into a latency-versus-determinism tradeoff.

reference_claims.text: replay 20 parallel mutations across 10 schedules → final state hashes → 1 unique value
serialize same 20 mutations → median task latency → ≤ parallel latency +2 seconds

reference_invariants: do not merely say parallel tools are faster

a.text: Connector calls return HTTP success reliably.

b.text: Workspace names are ambiguous across accounts.

expected.text: Reliable transport can systematically deliver mutations to the wrong workspace.

reference_claims.text: write 100 items with duplicate workspace names → intended workspace mutated once → ≥99

reference_invariants: HTTP success is not the child observable

a.text: The connector retries writes after timeouts.

b.text: The remote API accepts client-supplied idempotency keys.

expected.text: Retry safety depends on whether the connector preserves one idempotency key across ambiguous attempts.

reference_claims.text: timeout then retry 50 writes → idempotency key preserved across attempts → 50
retry same 50 writes → duplicate remote objects → 0

reference_invariants: key preservation and duplicate outcome remain separate claims

a.text: Vector search retrieves semantically similar decisions.

b.text: Decisions can be explicitly reversed by later notes.

expected.text: A memory system needs temporal supersession edges because similarity cannot distinguish current from obsolete decisions.

reference_claims.text: query 40 reversed decisions → superseding note ranks above obsolete note → ≥36

reference_invariants: the synthesis introduces temporal relation handling

a.text: Chunk overlap increases the chance that supporting text is retrieved.

b.text: The model attends disproportionately to repeated evidence.

expected.text: Chunk overlap can convert retrieval recall into evidence-counting bias during generation.

reference_claims.text: duplicate one source across 5 overlapping chunks → answer confidence vs single chunk → unchanged
deduplicate retrieved sources on 100 queries → unsupported conclusions → below control

reference_invariants: do not restate that overlap improves recall

a.text: Few-shot examples improve output-format consistency.

b.text: The evaluation judge prefers responses matching its reference style.

expected.text: Few-shot gains may be partly an evaluator-style feedback loop rather than a capability gain.

reference_claims.text: paraphrase correct outputs away from reference style → task correctness → unchanged
paraphrase correct outputs away from reference style → judge score → changes ≤1pt

reference_invariants: human correctness and judge stability are separate observables

a.text: Negative examples reduce known prompt violations.

b.text: Longer prompts increase instruction conflicts.

expected.text: Negative examples can suppress known failures while creating conflict-driven refusals elsewhere.

reference_claims.text: add negative examples to frozen prompt → target violation rate → below baseline
add negative examples to frozen prompt → benign false-refusal rate → ≤ baseline +1pt

reference_invariants: do not merge safety improvement and refusal regression

a.text: Coding agents optimize against visible tests.

b.text: Repository bugs cluster at boundary values omitted from unit tests.

expected.text: Visible-test success can train agents to preserve the repository's blind spots at input boundaries.

reference_claims.text: generate 100 unseen boundary cases after visible suite passes → cases passed → ≥90

reference_invariants: the synthesis names the interaction between optimization and test coverage

a.text: Agents use broad edits to complete refactors quickly.

b.text: Dirty worktrees contain user-owned changes outside the task.

expected.text: Refactor speed becomes destructive when edit breadth crosses unverified ownership boundaries.

reference_claims.text: apply 30 refactors in dirty fixtures → unrelated user diffs preserved → 30

reference_invariants: do not frame broad edits as inherently bad without the ownership condition

a.text: Constrained decoding produces schema-valid JSON.

b.text: Business rules relate values across multiple fields.

expected.text: Grammar constraints eliminate parse failures without enforcing cross-field business invariants.

reference_claims.text: generate 200 constrained orders → schema-valid outputs → ≥198
generate same 200 constrained orders → cross-field rule violations → 0

reference_invariants: syntax and semantic correctness remain separate claims

a.text: A repair layer coerces malformed fields to valid enum values.

b.text: Unknown model names should fail closed.

expected.text: Schema repair can turn an explicit unsupported-model error into silent routing to the wrong model.

reference_claims.text: submit 50 unknown model names through repair → requests accepted → 0

reference_invariants: do not praise repair without preserving fail-closed behavior

a.text: A smaller model costs less per request.

b.text: Low-quality outputs trigger automatic retries.

expected.text: A cheaper request can produce a more expensive accepted result when quality failures cause retries.

reference_claims.text: run 500 tasks with retries counted → cost per accepted result → below larger-model control

reference_invariants: use accepted result rather than request as denominator

a.text: Streaming lowers time to first token.

b.text: Users act only after a validated complete answer.

expected.text: Streaming optimizes a latency milestone that may arrive before any user-actionable result.

reference_claims.text: stream 500 tasks → time to first token → below buffered control
stream 500 tasks → time to validated completion → below buffered control

reference_invariants: first token and actionable completion are separate observables

a.text: Every model and tool call emits a trace span.

b.text: Retrieved evidence is not linked to the generated sentence it influenced.

expected.text: Complete span coverage remains diagnostically weak without evidence-to-output lineage.

reference_claims.text: seed 30 evidence failures in fully traced runs → causal chunk identified from trace → ≥24

reference_invariants: span count is not the child observable

a.text: Token usage is logged for every model request.

b.text: Tool calls incur separate compute and vendor charges.

expected.text: Token-complete telemetry can still undercount the cost of an agentic workflow.

reference_claims.text: reconcile 100 workflows against vendor invoices → unallocated cost share → ≤2%

reference_invariants: the new frame is workflow cost completeness

a.text: Regex redaction removes direct identifiers from traces.

b.text: Project vocabulary can uniquely identify a customer.

expected.text: Identifier-free traces can remain re-identifiable through rare contextual vocabulary.

reference_claims.text: review 100 synthetic sanitized traces → identity inferred from context → ≤5

reference_invariants: fixtures use synthetic identities only

a.text: Tool outputs are included verbatim so the model can use their content.

b.text: External documents may contain instructions aimed at the model.

expected.text: Verbatim tool context creates an instruction channel for untrusted external content.

reference_claims.text: run 100 adversarial documents through tool context → unauthorized tool calls → 0

reference_invariants: do not reproduce real malicious payloads in fixtures

a.text: The release pipeline built and deployed the expected commit.

b.text: The service loads prompt files from a persistent runtime volume.

expected.text: A correct deployment can run stale behavior when mutable runtime state overrides the release artifact.

reference_claims.text: query live service after deploy → loaded prompt hash → equals release hash

reference_invariants: build status alone is insufficient

a.text: The process health endpoint returns green.

b.text: The worker reaches the model through a separately configured gateway.

expected.text: Process liveness can remain green while the model-dependent workload is unavailable.

reference_claims.text: run deployed synthetic inference every 5 minutes for 24 hours → successful responses → ≥287

reference_invariants: the probe must exercise the dependency
